request.description:
Production binds WORKER_AGENTS, so every worker attempt takes startHostedAttempt. hostedBoot forces harness pi-durable, the agent is started on model 'sonnet', no claudeSub interception is installed, and the container env carries TICKS_CLAUDE_SUB=1 with TICKS_HARNESS=pi-durable, which image/common.sh dies on. The handle names pi-durable/sonnet, which the Go executor refuses under CloudBillingAllows. The lease taken in deps.boot is never released (no collect follows a refused start), so it holds a cap slot until the 2h TTL. Every claude-sub door test sets WORKER_AGENTS undefined, so this path is untested. Fix: route a subscription-rung attempt to a worker that runs the claude CLI under the interception, or make the agent host it. Add a test with WORKER_AGENTS bound that the Go executor accepts end to end.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts:715 and :959 hostedBoot; cloudflare/src/worker-agent.ts:215; image/common.sh:229; cloudflare/test/sandbox-dispatch.test.ts:367; Go repro: fake door bootedHarness=WorkerAgentHarness on a claude/sonnet start -> 'running on pi-durable/sonnet, which the cloud billing rule refuses'

ticfac run epic-v5t filed this backlog tick from the finding d7060f572e0ae2275be3d0fb6cb706c6285bab2b902a8a40854e497fae8b19c9 (reported by run-epic-v5t/tick-54l/attempt-6) rather than absorb it into the running epic: its reporter rated it high severity and named the done it breaks, but the epic's work was done when it was reported, so it is deferred to the final reviewer. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-v5t/absorptions/d7060f572e0ae2275be3d0fb6cb706c6285bab2b902a8a40854e497fae8b19c9.json on the run branch.
request.title: Hosted WorkerAgent door ignores the claude-sub rung; every rung job dies
